# SageStone Inc

SageStone Inc provides virtual assistant services, customer support outsourcing, ecommerce support, website maintenance, and business operations support for founders, small businesses, agencies, startups, real estate teams, and growing teams.

The brand voice is calm, capable, organized, proactive, premium, discreet, and human-first. SageStone helps teams delegate recurring administrative work, inbox management, calendar management, CRM organization, customer communication, SOP documentation, ecommerce support, and back-office workflows without adding payroll.

## Key URLs

- https://www.sagestoneinc.com/
  - Overview of SageStone Inc virtual assistant services and operations support.
- https://www.sagestoneinc.com/virtual-assistant-services/
  - Virtual assistant services for inbox, calendar, CRM, research, reporting, documentation, and recurring admin workflows.
- https://www.sagestoneinc.com/customer-support-outsourcing/
  - Customer support outsourcing for email, chat, help desk triage, customer follow-up, and escalation workflows.
- https://www.sagestoneinc.com/ecommerce-virtual-assistant/
  - Ecommerce virtual assistant services for Shopify support, product updates, orders, returns, customer inboxes, and store operations.
- https://www.sagestoneinc.com/business-operations-support/
  - Business operations support for SOPs, CRM hygiene, reporting, admin coordination, meeting notes, and back-office follow-through.
- https://www.sagestoneinc.com/real-estate-virtual-assistant/
  - Real estate virtual assistant support for CRM updates, listing coordination, lead follow-up, scheduling, and transaction admin.
- https://www.sagestoneinc.com/social-media-virtual-assistant/
  - Social media virtual assistant support for content calendars, scheduling, engagement tracking, asset organization, and reporting prep.
- https://www.sagestoneinc.com/web-maintenance-support/

- https://www.sagestoneinc.com/blog/
